clock: document_date — supersession folds on document dates (the default; set `change.clock = "narrative"` for order within a work)
tension selector: embedding top-k (k = 10, floor = 0.5) over rule — cross-document declared corpora select the embedding net; the classifier judges each pair
identity: topic → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
question shapes: enumerate [topic]; relations [(none)]; events [(none)]; aggregate [(none — a claim type with a `ref` attribute can be counted by it)]
